title: SkillSpec: Intent-Masked Specification Reasoning for Agent Skill Correctness
abstract: arXiv:2609.06052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous agent systems increasingly depend on reusable skill abstractions for consolidating experiential knowledge and domain expertise. These artifacts typically bundle free-form instructions with heterogeneous resources. However, ensuring their correctness remains challenging. Their failure modes transcend conventional code defects to subtle semantic inconsistencies such as intent conflicts, which manifest as silent failures masked by the underlying model. Moreover, skill correctness must be grounded in intended task boundaries and generalizability. We propose SkillSpec, a Hoare-style framework that formulates skill correctness as a specification reasoning problem. It transforms a heterogeneous skill repository into a unified graph representation that aligns descriptions, instructions and code artifacts. translated_title: SkillSpec：面向智能体技能正确性的意图掩码式规范推理
translated_abstract: 自主智能体系统日益依赖于可复用的技能抽象来整合经验知识与领域专业能力。这些产物通常将自由格式的指令与异构资源捆绑在一起，然而确保其正确性仍然充满挑战。它们的失效模式超越了传统的代码缺陷，延伸至细微的语义不一致问题，例如意图冲突——这类冲突表现为被底层模型掩盖的静默失败。此外，技能的正确性必须以预期的任务边界和泛化能力为依据。我们提出了 SkillSpec，一个 Hoare 风格的框架，它将技能正确性形式化为一个规范推理问题。该框架将异构的技能仓库转换为统一的图表示，对齐描述、指令和代码工件。对于每个节点，SkillSpec 从周围声明的意图中推导出 ExpectSpec（期望规范），并从已编码的行为中推断 FactSpecs（事实规范）……
tldr: 提出 SkillSpec 框架，将智能体技能正确性形式化为 Hoare 风格的规范推理问题，通过将异构技能仓库转化为统一图表示并对比声明意图（ExpectSpec）与实际行为（FactSpecs），以检测意图冲突等被模型掩盖的静默失败。
en_tdlr: SkillSpec is a Hoare-style framework that formulates agent skill correctness as intent-masked specification reasoning, transforming heterogeneous skill repositories into a unified graph representation and comparing declared intents (ExpectSpec) against encoded behaviors (FactSpecs) to detect silent failures such as intent conflicts.
